title: "`r params$title`"
date: today
date-format: long
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 3
    embed-resources: true
    code-fold: true
    fig-align: center
params:
  tse_path: NULL
  assay_type: "counts"
  title: "ViroProfiler Quality Report"
  covfrac_threshold: "none"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
  dev = "png", dpi = 150, fig.retina = 2
)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(ggplot2)

if (is.null(params$tse_path) || !nzchar(params$tse_path) || !file.exists(params$tse_path)) {
  stop("Report parameter 'tse_path' does not point at a readable file.")
}
tse <- readRDS(params$tse_path)

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## This template is deliberately self-contained: it uses only SummarizedExperiment
## and ggplot2 so that it renders during package checks, when vpfkit itself may
## not be installed in the rendering subprocess.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

## What each ViroProfiler assay actually measures. "tmm" is a legacy name for
## CoverM's trimmed mean of per-base coverage depth; it is not edgeR's Trimmed
## Mean of M-values.
assay_aliases <- list(
  counts         = c("counts", "count"),
  tpm            = c("tpm", "TPM"),
  trimmed_mean   = c("trimmed_mean", "tmm", "trimmed.mean"),
  covfrac        = c("covfrac", "covered_fraction", "coverage_fraction"),
  reads_per_base = c("reads_per_base", "rpb"),
  rpkm           = c("rpkm", "RPKM")
)
assay_units <- c(
  counts         = "CoverM read count (reads mapped per contig per sample)",
  tpm            = "CoverM TPM (transcripts per million; each column sums to 1e6)",
  trimmed_mean   = "CoverM trimmed mean of per-base coverage depth (fold)",
  covfrac        = "CoverM covered fraction, i.e. breadth of coverage (0-1)",
  reads_per_base = "CoverM reads per base (reads mapped / contig length)",
  rpkm           = "CoverM RPKM"
)
canonical_assay <- function(x) {
  for (nm in names(assay_aliases)) if (x %in% assay_aliases[[nm]]) return(nm)
  x
}
match_assay <- function(obj, name) {
  available <- assayNames(obj)
  if (name %in% available) return(name)
  cand <- assay_aliases[[canonical_assay(name)]]
  hit <- if (is.null(cand)) character(0) else intersect(cand, available)
  if (length(hit)) hit[[1]] else NA_character_
}
## Newer objects carry the authoritative unit strings written by
## create_vpftse(). Prefer those; the table above is the fallback for objects
## built before that metadata existed.
vp_meta <- S4Vectors::metadata(tse)$viroprofiler
assay_doc <- if (is.list(vp_meta) && is.list(vp_meta$assays)) vp_meta$assays else NULL
describe_assay <- function(name) {
  cn <- canonical_assay(name)
  if (!is.null(assay_doc) && cn %in% names(assay_doc)) return(as.character(assay_doc[[cn]]))
  if (cn %in% names(assay_units)) unname(assay_units[cn]) else "user-supplied assay (units unknown)"
}

rd <- as.data.frame(rowData(tse), optional = TRUE)
cd <- as.data.frame(colData(tse), optional = TRUE)
n_contigs <- nrow(tse)
n_samples <- ncol(tse)

## Resolve the working assays once.
main_assay <- match_assay(tse, params$assay_type)
covfrac_assay <- match_assay(tse, "covfrac")

## Coverage-breadth masking. The threshold arrives as a string so that "none"
## can travel through the YAML parameter file alongside numeric values.
thr_raw <- params$covfrac_threshold
covfrac_threshold <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(thr_raw))
masking_applied <- FALSE
n_masked <- 0L
if (!is.na(covfrac_threshold) && !is.na(main_assay) && !is.na(covfrac_assay)) {
  ab <- as.matrix(assay(tse, main_assay))
  cf <- as.matrix(assay(tse, covfrac_assay))
  keep <- !is.na(cf) & cf >= covfrac_threshold
  n_masked <- sum(ab > 0 & !keep, na.rm = TRUE)
  ab[!keep] <- 0
  assay(tse, main_assay) <- ab
  masking_applied <- TRUE
}

## Helper: emit a plain explanatory note instead of a failed chunk.
note <- function(...) {
  cat("\n::: {.callout-note appearance=\"simple\"}\n", ..., "\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
}

## `%||%` is only in base R from 4.4.0 onwards.
`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x
```

## Dataset summary

```{r summary, output='asis'}
cat(sprintf("- **Contigs**: %s\n", format(n_contigs, big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf("- **Samples**: %s\n", format(n_samples, big.mark = ",")))
cat("- **Assays**:\n")
for (a in assayNames(tse)) {
  cat(sprintf("    - `%s` — %s\n", a, describe_assay(a)))
}
if ("checkv_contig_length" %in% colnames(rd)) {
  L <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(rd$checkv_contig_length))
  if (any(is.finite(L))) {
    cat(sprintf("- **Total contig length**: %s bp\n", format(sum(L, na.rm = TRUE), big.mark = ",")))
    cat(sprintf("- **Median contig length**: %s bp\n",
                format(round(stats::median(L, na.rm = TRUE)), big.mark = ",")))
  }
}
cat(sprintf("- **Annotation columns**: %d\n", ncol(rd)))
```

```{r summary-warnings, output='asis'}
if (n_contigs == 0L) {
  note("This object contains no contigs. Every section below is empty.")
} else if (n_samples < 3L) {
  note(
    sprintf("This dataset has %d sample%s. ", n_samples, if (n_samples == 1L) "" else "s"),
    "Sections that compare samples (ordination, group testing) need at least three ",
    "and are reported as unavailable rather than estimated from too little data."
  )
}
```

## How these contigs were selected

```{r viral-selection, output='asis'}
vs <- S4Vectors::metadata(tse)$viral_selection
if (is.null(vs)) {
  note("This object carries no viral-selection record, so it holds every ",
       "assembled contig rather than a selected viral subset. Build the subset ",
       "with `create_vpftse_vir()` to record how the decision was made.")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("- **Rule**: %s\n", as.character(vs$rule %||% "unknown")))
  if (!is.null(vs$combination)) cat(sprintf("- **Combination**: %s\n", as.character(vs$combination)))
  if (!is.null(vs$n_selected) && !is.null(vs$n_total)) {
    cat(sprintf("- **Selected**: %s of %s contigs (%.1f%%)\n",
                format(vs$n_selected, big.mark = ","), format(vs$n_total, big.mark = ","),
                100 * vs$n_selected / max(1L, vs$n_total)))
  }
  if (!is.null(vs$votes_used)) {
    cat(sprintf("- **Detectors used**: %s\n", paste(as.character(vs$votes_used), collapse = ", ")))
  }
  if (length(vs$votes_missing)) {
    cat(sprintf("- **Detectors unavailable**: %s\n",
                paste(as.character(vs$votes_missing), collapse = ", ")))
  }
  if (!is.null(vs$n_by_vote) && length(vs$n_by_vote)) {
    cat("\n")
    print(knitr::kable(
      data.frame(Detector = names(vs$n_by_vote),
                 `Contigs supported` = as.integer(vs$n_by_vote), check.names = FALSE),
      row.names = FALSE))
    cat("\n")
  }
}
```

```{r evidence-note, output='asis'}
if (has_votes) {
  single <- sum(rd$viral_vote_n <= 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("\n%d of %d contigs (%.0f%%) rest on a single detector. Those are the ",
              single, n_contigs, 100 * single / max(1L, n_contigs)))
  cat("calls most likely to be false positives.\n")
  if ("viral_vote_evidence" %in% colnames(rd)) {
    ev <- as.data.frame(table(rd$viral_vote_evidence, useNA = "no"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    if (nrow(ev)) {
      colnames(ev) <- c("Evidence combination", "Contigs")
      ev <- utils::head(ev[order(-ev$Contigs), ], 10)
      cat("\n")
      print(knitr::kable(ev, row.names = FALSE))
      cat("\n")

}
```

## Annotation join quality

```{r join-match, output='asis'}
jm <- if (is.list(vp_meta)) vp_meta$join_match else NULL
if (is.null(jm) || length(jm) == 0L) {
  note("No per-tool join statistics are recorded in this object, so the share ",
       "of contigs each annotation table matched cannot be shown.")
} else {
  rows <- lapply(names(jm), function(tool) {
    s <- jm[[tool]]
    data.frame(
      Tool = tool,
      Matched = as.integer(s$matched %||% NA),
      `Rows in table` = as.integer(s$n_table %||% s$total %||% NA),
      `Match rate` = if (!is.null(s$rate)) sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * s$rate) else NA_character_,
      check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  tab <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  cat("\nHow many contigs each annotation table matched. A low rate usually ",
      "means mismatched contig identifiers rather than missing biology.\n\n", sep = "")
  print(knitr::kable(tab, row.names = FALSE))
  cat("\n")
}
```

## Abundance provenance

```{r provenance, output='asis'}
if (is.na(main_assay)) {
  note(sprintf("Assay '%s' is not present, so no abundance is summarized. Available: %s.",
               params$assay_type,
               if (length(assayNames(tse))) paste(assayNames(tse), collapse = ", ") else "none"))
} else {
  cat(sprintf("- **Assay used below**: `%s` — %s\n", main_assay, describe_assay(main_assay)))
  if (masking_applied) {
    cat(sprintf(
      paste0("- **Coverage-breadth masking**: applied at covered fraction >= %s, ",
             "using assay `%s`. %s of the non-zero entries were set to zero.\n"),
      format(covfrac_threshold), covfrac_assay, format(n_masked, big.mark = ",")))
    cat(paste0("- **Order of operations**: masking was applied to the stored `",
               main_assay, "` values before anything below was computed.\n"))
    if (canonical_assay(main_assay) %in% c("tpm", "rpkm")) {
      cat(paste0("- **Caveat**: `", main_assay, "` is already normalized. Masking it after ",
                 "normalization leaves each sample with its own residual scaling factor, so ",
                 "columns no longer sum to a common total. Mask raw counts and re-normalize ",
                 "instead.\n"))
    }
  } else {
    cat("- **Coverage-breadth masking**: not applied. Values are shown exactly as stored.\n")
  }
}
```

```{r provenance-note, output='asis'}
note(
  "A viral contig can accumulate reads over one short conserved stretch while the rest ",
  "of its length has no coverage at all. Requiring a minimum **breadth** of coverage ",
  "before an abundance is believed removes most of those false positives. The commonly ",
  "used convention is 75% of the contig covered at least once, combined with a strict ",
  "read identity threshold (Roux et al., 2017, *PeerJ* 5:e3817, doi:10.7717/peerj.3817); ",
  "the ViroProfiler paper uses 50% (Ru et al., 2023, *Gut Microbes*, ",
  "doi:10.1080/19490976.2023.2192522). Masking belongs **before** normalization: masking ",
  "an already-normalized matrix without renormalizing gives every sample a different ",
  "scaling factor (Kuzub et al., 2025, *Nat Commun*, doi:10.1038/s41467-025-61478-7)."
)
```

## Coverage breadth

```{r covfrac-table, output='asis'}
if (is.na(covfrac_assay) || n_contigs == 0L) {
  note("No covered-fraction assay is stored, so coverage breadth cannot be summarized.")
} else {
  cf <- as.matrix(assay(tse, covfrac_assay))
  thresholds <- c(0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9)
  tab <- data.frame(
    `Minimum covered fraction` = sprintf(">= %.2f", thresholds),
    `Contig-sample pairs retained` = vapply(
      thresholds, function(t) sum(!is.na(cf) & cf >= t), integer(1)),
    `Percent of non-zero pairs` = sprintf(
      "%.1f%%",
      100 * vapply(thresholds, function(t) sum(!is.na(cf) & cf >= t), integer(1)) /
        max(1L, sum(!is.na(cf) & cf > 0))),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  cat("\nHow many contig-sample pairs survive each candidate threshold:\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(tab, row.names = FALSE))
  cat("\n")
}
```

```{r covfrac-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
if (!is.na(covfrac_assay) && n_contigs > 0L) {
  cf <- as.matrix(assay(tse, covfrac_assay))
  dfc <- data.frame(covfrac = as.vector(cf),
                    Sample = rep(colnames(cf) %||% seq_len(ncol(cf)), each = nrow(cf)))
  dfc <- dfc[!is.na(dfc$covfrac) & dfc$covfrac > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(dfc) > 0) {
    p <- ggplot(dfc, aes(x = covfrac)) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "#4ECDC4", colour = "white") +
      facet_wrap(~ Sample) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(x = "Covered fraction (breadth of coverage)", y = "Contig-sample pairs",
           title = "Coverage breadth of detected contigs",
           subtitle = "Zero-coverage pairs omitted")
    if (!is.na(covfrac_threshold)) {
      p <- p + geom_vline(xintercept = covfrac_threshold, linetype = 2, colour = "#D7263D")
    }
    print(p)
  }
}
```

## Sample metadata

```{r sample-metadata, output='asis'}
if (ncol(cd) == 0L) {
  note("`colData` is empty, so no sample metadata can be shown.")
} else {
  print(knitr::kable(utils::head(cd, 50), row.names = TRUE))
  cat("\n")
  ## A grouping variable is any categorical column with 2+ levels that is not a
  ## per-sample identifier.
  is_group <- vapply(names(cd), function(nm) {
    v <- cd[[nm]]
    if (!(is.character(v) || is.factor(v) || is.logical(v))) return(FALSE)
    k <- length(unique(v[!is.na(v)]))
    k >= 2L && k < length(v)
  }, logical(1))
  if (any(is_group)) {
    cat(sprintf("\nCandidate grouping variable(s): %s\n",
                paste(sprintf("`%s`", names(cd)[is_group]), collapse = ", ")))
  } else {
    cat("\n")
    note("No grouping variable is present in `colData`: every metadata column is either ",
         "numeric or unique per sample. Group comparisons are therefore not shown. ",
         "Add a sample-metadata column to enable them.")
  }
}
```

## Taxonomy

```{r taxonomy, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
ranks <- c("Domain", "Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")
present_ranks <- intersect(ranks, colnames(rd))
plot_rank <- NA_character_
if (length(present_ranks) > 0 && n_contigs > 0L) {
  ## Prefer Family; fall back to the most finely resolved rank that has at
  ## least one assignment.
  informative <- vapply(present_ranks, function(r) {
    v <- as.character(rd[[r]]); sum(!is.na(v) & nzchar(v) & v != "NA") > 0
  }, logical(1))
  if (any(informative)) {
    plot_rank <- if ("Family" %in% present_ranks[informative]) "Family" else
      utils::tail(present_ranks[informative], 1)
  }
}
if (!is.na(plot_rank)) {
  v <- as.character(rd[[plot_rank]])
  v[is.na(v) | !nzchar(v) | v == "NA"] <- "Unassigned"
  fc <- as.data.frame(table(v), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  colnames(fc) <- c("Taxon", "Count")
  fc <- utils::head(fc[order(-fc$Count), ], 20)
  ## Long "novel_family_1_of_novel_order_22_of_Caudoviricetes" labels are the
  ## norm in viral taxonomy; wrap rather than truncate.
  fc$Taxon <- vapply(fc$Taxon, function(s) paste(strwrap(s, width = 42), collapse = "\n"), character(1))
  ggplot(fc, aes(x = stats::reorder(Taxon, Count), y = Count)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#4ECDC4") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    labs(title = sprintf("Contigs per %s (top %d)", plot_rank, nrow(fc)), x = NULL,
         y = "Number of contigs")
}
```

```{r taxonomy-note, output='asis'}
if (is.na(plot_rank)) {
  note(if (length(present_ranks) == 0)
         "No taxonomic rank columns are present, so taxonomy is not summarized."
       else sprintf("Rank columns are present (%s) but every value is missing.",
                    paste(present_ranks, collapse = ", ")))
} else {
  n_unassigned <- sum(is.na(rd[[plot_rank]]) | !nzchar(as.character(rd[[plot_rank]])) |
                        as.character(rd[[plot_rank]]) == "NA")
  cat(sprintf("\n%d of %d contigs (%.0f%%) have no %s assignment.\n",
              n_unassigned, n_contigs, 100 * n_unassigned / max(1L, n_contigs), plot_rank))
}
```

## Alpha diversity

```{r alpha-diversity, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
alpha_status <- "ok"
alpha_df <- NULL
if (is.na(main_assay)) {
  alpha_status <- "no-assay"
} else if (canonical_assay(main_assay) %in% c("covfrac")) {
  alpha_status <- "wrong-assay"
} else if (n_samples < 1L || n_contigs < 2L) {
  alpha_status <- "too-small"
} else {
  m <- as.matrix(assay(tse, main_assay))
  m[!is.finite(m)] <- 0
  ## Shannon computed directly: no dependency on which mia generation is
  ## installed, and no silent behaviour change when mia renames its functions.
  shannon <- apply(m, 2, function(x) {
    x <- x[x > 0]
    if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
    p <- x / sum(x)
    -sum(p * log(p))
  })
  observed <- apply(m, 2, function(x) sum(x > 0))
  alpha_df <- data.frame(
    Sample = colnames(m) %||% paste0("S", seq_len(ncol(m))),
    Shannon = shannon, Observed = observed, check.names = FALSE
  )
}
if (!is.null(alpha_df)) {
  ad <- alpha_df[is.finite(alpha_df$Shannon), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(ad) > 0) {
    ggplot(ad, aes(x = stats::reorder(Sample, -Shannon), y = Shannon)) +
      geom_col(fill = "#2196F3", width = 0.6) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(title = "Shannon diversity per sample", x = NULL, y = "Shannon index",
           subtitle = sprintf("Computed from assay `%s`%s", main_assay,
                              if (masking_applied) sprintf(", masked at covered fraction >= %s",
                                                           format(covfrac_threshold)) else ", unmasked")) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  }
}
```

```{r alpha-note, output='asis'}
if (!is.null(alpha_df)) {
  print(knitr::kable(alpha_df, row.names = FALSE, digits = 3))
  cat("\n")
} else {
  note(switch(alpha_status,
    "no-assay"    = "No usable abundance assay, so diversity is not computed.",
    "wrong-assay" = paste0("The selected assay is a covered fraction, which measures breadth ",
                           "of coverage rather than abundance. Diversity indices computed from ",
                           "it would be meaningless, so none are shown."),
    "too-small"   = "Too few contigs or samples to compute a diversity index.",
    "Diversity is not available for this dataset."))
}
```

```{r alpha-by-group, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
group_col <- NULL
if (ncol(cd) > 0L) {
  cand <- vapply(names(cd), function(nm) {
    v <- cd[[nm]]
    if (!(is.character(v) || is.factor(v) || is.logical(v))) return(FALSE)
    k <- length(unique(v[!is.na(v)]))
    k >= 2L && k < length(v)
  }, logical(1))
  if (any(cand)) group_col <- names(cd)[cand][1]
}
group_alpha_status <- "none"
if (!is.null(alpha_df) && !is.null(group_col)) {
  ad <- alpha_df[is.finite(alpha_df$Shannon), , drop = FALSE]
  ad$Group <- as.character(cd[[group_col]])[match(ad$Sample, rownames(cd))]
  ad <- ad[!is.na(ad$Group), , drop = FALSE]
  sizes <- table(ad$Group)
  if (length(sizes) >= 2L && min(sizes) >= 3L) {
    group_alpha_status <- "ok"
    p <- ggplot(ad, aes(x = Group, y = Shannon, fill = Group)) +
      geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.55) +
      geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(title = sprintf("Shannon diversity by %s", group_col),
           subtitle = sprintf("Assay `%s`%s", main_assay,
                              if (masking_applied)
                                sprintf(", masked at covered fraction >= %s", format(covfrac_threshold))
                              else ", unmasked"),
           x = NULL, y = "Shannon index") +
      theme(legend.position = "none")
    print(p)
  } else {
    group_alpha_status <- "too-small"
  }
}
```

```{r alpha-by-group-note, output='asis'}
if (group_alpha_status == "ok") {
  ad <- alpha_df[is.finite(alpha_df$Shannon), , drop = FALSE]
  ad$Group <- as.character(cd[[group_col]])[match(ad$Sample, rownames(cd))]
  ad <- ad[!is.na(ad$Group), , drop = FALSE]
  k <- length(unique(ad$Group))
  ## Rank-based throughout: sample sizes here are small and Shannon indices
  ## are not expected to be normally distributed.
  tt <- tryCatch(
    if (k == 2L) stats::wilcox.test(Shannon ~ factor(Group), data = ad, exact = FALSE)
    else stats::kruskal.test(Shannon ~ factor(Group), data = ad),
    error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(tt)) {
    cat(sprintf("\n%s: p = %.3g (n = %s).\n", tt$method, tt$p.value,
                paste(sprintf("%s: %d", names(table(ad$Group)), as.integer(table(ad$Group))),
                      collapse = ", ")))
    cat("\nThis is a single unadjusted test on one index; treat it as descriptive.\n")
  }
} else if (group_alpha_status == "too-small") {
  note(sprintf("A grouping variable (`%s`) is present, but at least one group has ", group_col),
       "fewer than three samples, so no group comparison is reported.")
}
```

## Beta diversity

```{r beta-diversity, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=5}
beta_status <- "ok"
beta_p <- NULL
if (n_samples < 3L) {
  beta_status <- "too-few-samples"
} else if (is.na(main_assay) || canonical_assay(main_assay) == "covfrac") {
  beta_status <- "wrong-assay"
} else if (!requireNamespace("vegan", quietly = TRUE)) {
  beta_status <- "no-vegan"
} else {
  m <- as.matrix(assay(tse, main_assay))
  m[!is.finite(m)] <- 0
  ## Samples with nothing in them make Bray-Curtis undefined.
  keep <- colSums(m) > 0
  if (sum(keep) < 3L) {
    beta_status <- "empty-samples"
  } else {
    m <- m[, keep, drop = FALSE]
    d <- vegan::vegdist(t(m), method = "bray")
    if (anyNA(d)) {
      beta_status <- "undefined-distance"
    } else {
      pc <- stats::cmdscale(d, k = 2, eig = TRUE)
      eig <- pc$eig
      pct <- if (any(eig > 0)) 100 * eig / sum(eig[eig > 0]) else c(NA, NA)
      dfb <- data.frame(Axis1 = pc$points[, 1], Axis2 = pc$points[, 2],
                        Sample = rownames(pc$points))
      dfb$Group <- if (!is.null(group_col))
        as.character(cd[[group_col]])[match(dfb$Sample, rownames(cd))] else "All samples"

      p <- ggplot(dfb, aes(x = Axis1, y = Axis2, colour = Group)) +
        geom_point(size = 3) +
        theme_minimal() +
        labs(title = "PCoA on Bray-Curtis dissimilarity",
             subtitle = sprintf("Assay `%s`%s", main_assay,
                                if (masking_applied)
                                  sprintf(", masked at covered fraction >= %s", format(covfrac_threshold))
                                else ", unmasked"),
             x = if (is.na(pct[1])) "Axis 1" else sprintf("Axis 1 (%.1f%%)", pct[1]),
             y = if (is.na(pct[2])) "Axis 2" else sprintf("Axis 2 (%.1f%%)", pct[2]))
      if (is.null(group_col)) p <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")
      ## An ellipse needs more than three points per group.
      if (!is.null(group_col) && min(table(dfb$Group)) >= 4L) {
        p <- p + ggplot2::stat_ellipse(alpha = 0.6, linetype = 2)
      }
      print(p)

      if (!is.null(group_col) && length(unique(dfb$Group)) >= 2L &&
          min(table(dfb$Group)) >= 3L) {
        beta_p <- tryCatch({
          set.seed(1)
          a <- vegan::adonis2(d ~ Group, data = dfb, permutations = 999)
          list(p = a$`Pr(>F)`[1], r2 = a$R2[1])
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r beta-note, output='asis'}
if (beta_status == "ok") {
  if (!is.null(beta_p)) {
    cat(sprintf("\nPERMANOVA on Bray-Curtis distances by `%s`: R2 = %.3f, p = %.3g (999 permutations).\n",
                group_col, beta_p$r2, beta_p$p))
    cat("\nPERMANOVA is sensitive to unequal within-group dispersion; a significant ",
        "result can reflect a difference in spread rather than in location.\n", sep = "")
  } else if (!is.null(group_col)) {
    cat("\nToo few samples per group for a PERMANOVA.\n")
  }
} else {
  note(switch(beta_status,
    "too-few-samples" = sprintf(
      paste0("Ordination needs at least three samples to place points in a meaningful ",
             "space; this dataset has %d. A distance between two samples is a single ",
             "number and carries no ordination geometry, so no plot is shown."), n_samples),
    "wrong-assay" = paste0("The selected assay is a covered fraction, which measures ",
                           "breadth of coverage rather than abundance, so no dissimilarity ",
                           "is computed from it."),
    "no-vegan" = "The vegan package is unavailable, so no ordination is shown.",
    "empty-samples" = "Fewer than three samples contain any signal in the selected assay.",
    "undefined-distance" = "The Bray-Curtis dissimilarity is undefined for these samples.",
    "No ordination is available for this dataset."))
}
```

## Abundance overview

```{r abundance-heatmap, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
has_ab <- !is.na(main_assay) && n_contigs > 0L && n_samples > 0L
if (has_ab) {
  m <- as.matrix(assay(tse, main_assay))
  m[!is.finite(m)] <- 0
  top_n <- min(30L, nrow(m))
  idx <- order(rowMeans(m), decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(top_n)]
  mt <- m[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  rn <- rownames(mt) %||% paste0("row", seq_len(nrow(mt)))
  ## Truncate only for display; contig names from SPAdes are very long.
  rn_short <- ifelse(nchar(rn) > 45, paste0(substr(rn, 1, 42), "..."), rn)
  dfh <- data.frame(
    Contig = factor(rep(rn_short, times = ncol(mt)), levels = rev(rn_short)),
    Sample = rep(colnames(mt) %||% paste0("S", seq_len(ncol(mt))), each = nrow(mt)),
    Value = as.vector(mt)
  )
  ## A ggplot tile map works for any shape. Base heatmap() clusters rows and
  ## columns and therefore fails outright on matrices with fewer than two rows
  ## or two columns, which is exactly the shape a small viral dataset has.
  ggplot(dfh, aes(x = Sample, y = Contig, fill = log1p(Value))) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F7FBFF", high = "#08519C", name = "log(1 + value)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    labs(title = sprintf("Top %d contigs by mean %s", top_n, main_assay),
         subtitle = sprintf("%s%s", describe_assay(main_assay),
                            if (masking_applied)
                              sprintf("; masked at covered fraction >= %s", format(covfrac_threshold))
                            else "; unmasked"),
         x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}
```

```{r abundance-note, output='asis'}
if (!has_ab) note("No abundance assay is available, so no abundance overview is shown.")
```

## Gene annotations

```{r gene-annotations, output='asis'}
ga <- S4Vectors::metadata(tse)$gene_annotations
if (is.null(ga) || !is.data.frame(as.data.frame(ga)) || nrow(as.data.frame(ga)) == 0L) {
  note(
    "No gene annotations are stored in `metadata(tse)$gene_annotations`. ",
    "ViroProfiler writes them when the DRAM-v and Pharokka steps run; a viral-contig ",
    "object built without those steps has none, which is not an error."
  )
} else {
  ga <- as.data.frame(ga)
  cat(sprintf("- **Genes annotated**: %s\n", format(nrow(ga), big.mark = ",")))
  blank <- function(x) is.na(x) | !nzchar(as.character(x)) | as.character(x) == "NA"
  if ("dramv_category" %in% colnames(ga)) {
    cat(sprintf("- **AMG genes**: %s\n",
                format(sum(ga$dramv_category == "AMG", na.rm = TRUE), big.mark = ",")))
    cat(sprintf("- **Viral genes**: %s\n",
                format(sum(ga$dramv_category == "viral", na.rm = TRUE), big.mark = ",")))
  }
  if ("pharokka_card" %in% colnames(ga)) {
    cat(sprintf("- **CARD hits (antibiotic resistance)**: %s\n",
                format(sum(!blank(ga$pharokka_card)), big.mark = ",")))
  }
  if ("pharokka_vfdb" %in% colnames(ga)) {
    cat(sprintf("- **VFDB hits (virulence factors)**: %s\n",
                format(sum(!blank(ga$pharokka_vfdb)), big.mark = ",")))
  }
}
```
